ladder.label: DOWNTREND
ladder.why: Failed cycle — price broke below the low that started this cycle, which historically means the larger trend is rolling over (~80% of cases).
ladder.next: Stand aside until a new daily cycle low forms and confirms.
ladder.regime_why: weekly momentum negative; investor cycle failed (broke its start low); investor cycle overdue
ladder.regime_line: Bigger picture: BEARISH — weekly momentum negative; investor cycle failed (broke its start low); investor cycle overdue (investor cycle week 29 · failed · daily cycle broke its start low 7d ago).
points: Bigger picture is bearish (counter-trend for a daily long)
Macro: US net liquidity contracting — caution on the odds
⚠ Failed cycle — price broke below the low that began this cycle (7d ago)
Swing low printed (buyers rejected the low)

entry.text: Downtrend — stand aside until a new cycle low forms and confirms.
entry.text_zh: 下跌趋势——观望，直至新的周期低点形成并确认。

cycle_plain.daily_line: Daily cycle: day 24 of a typical 36–42 trading days
cycle_plain.daily_line_zh: 日线周期：第 24 天，典型周期为 36–42 个交易日
cycle_plain.weekly_line: Weekly (investor) cycle: week 29 of a typical 16–26 weeks
cycle_plain.weekly_phase: overdue — the bigger cycle is stretched, expect more volatility
cycle_plain.weekly_line_zh: 周线（投资者）周期：第 29 周，典型周期为 16–26 周
cycle_plain.weekly_phase_zh: 逾期——更大的周期已被拉伸，预计波动加剧
cycle_plain.translation: The last cycle peaked in its SECOND half ('right-translated') — strong cycles top late, a healthy-uptrend sign.
cycle_plain.translation_zh: 上一周期在后半段见顶（“右移”）——强周期见顶偏晚，属于健康上涨趋势的信号。

ladder.why_zh: 失败周期——价格跌破了启动本周期的低点，历史上这通常意味着更大的趋势正在掉头向下（约 80% 的情形）。
ladder.next_zh: 观望，直至新的日线周期低点形成并确认。
ladder.regime_line_zh: 大局：看空 — 周线动量为负；投资者周期失败（跌破起始低点）；投资者周期已逾期（投资者周期第 29 周 · 已失败 · 日线周期于 7 天前跌破其起始低点）。
ladder.summary_line_zh: 短期（日线）：下跌趋势。大局（逆势）：看空。
points_zh: 大局为看空（对日线多头而言属逆势）
宏观：美国净流动性收缩——对概率属需谨慎
⚠ 失败周期——价格跌破了启动本周期的低点（7 天前）
摆动低点已现（买方拒绝了该低点）
仍位于 10 日均线之下
ladder.liq_line: Macro headwind: US net liquidity is contracting — buy setups have historically had worse odds and deeper drawdowns here, so demand extra confirmation and smaller size. An odds edge, not a forecast.
ladder.liq_line_zh: 宏观逆风：美国净流动性正在收缩——在此环境下买入形态历史上胜率更低、回撤更深，因此应要求更多确认并降低仓位。这是概率优势，并非预测。
ladder.age_line: ⏱ DOWNTREND signal triggered 7 trading days ago (~2026-06-09), switching from NEARING A LOW. Signal strength: strong (score -80/100).
ladder.age_line_zh: ⏱ 下跌趋势信号于 7 个交易日前触发（约 2026-06-09），自接近低点切换而来。 信号强度：强（评分 -80/100）。
ladder.eq_label_zh: 入场质量：偏弱卖出/离场形态（-29）
ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle high, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期高点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。
ladder.bc_line_zh: 日线 ✓ · 3日 ✗ · 周线 ✗ · 月线 —
ladder.bc_tip: Confidence this is a DURABLE, low-drawdown bottom: how near price is to the cycle low (the drawdown-depth axis) discounted when higher timeframes haven't confirmed the turn. Measured: weekly confirmation lifted the 'cycle-low held' rate ~19pp — a higher score held far more often. Risk/durability, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.bc_tip_zh: 衡量当前是否为「持久、低回撤」底部的信心：价格距周期低点的远近（回撤深度轴），并在更高周期尚未确认转向时打折。实测：周线确认使「周期低点守住」的比例提升约 19 个百分点——分数越高，低点守住的概率越大。这是风险/持久性，并非收益预测。
ladder.bc_knife_line: ⚠ Deep washout — price is 50% below its 200-day, a broken primary trend. Measured: setups this stretched below the 200-day held the cycle low only ~37% of the time and drew a ~−22% tail (violent bounces, rarely the durable low). Treat as knife-risk — wait for it to reclaim the 10-day average and size small. The score above is already tempered for this.
ladder.bc_knife_line_zh: ⚠ 深度超卖——价格较 200 日均线低约 50%（主趋势已破）。实测：如此远低于 200 日线的形态，仅约 37% 守住周期低点，且回撤尾部约 −22%（反弹猛烈，但很少是持久低点）。视为「接飞刀」风险——等其收复 10 日均线后再小仓参与。上方分数已据此打折。

accounting_quality.basis_zh: 多年趋势 + 同业排名
accounting_quality.caveat: Annual filings, lagged to the report date; free XBRL is sparse for some filers. Context, not a signal — it does not change the technical call.
accounting_quality.caveat_zh: 年度财报，滞后于披露日；免费 XBRL 数据对部分公司不全。仅供参考，并非交易信号，不改变技术面判断。

trust_tier.en: Event edge: insider buying (lone FDR survivor) + earnings-surprise PEAD context + revisions — a confluence read, not a standalone alpha
trust_tier.zh: 事件驱动优势：内部人买入（唯一通过 FDR 的因子）＋盈利超预期 PEAD 背景＋评级调整 — 综合参考，非独立超额收益

regime.en: Mixed tape — balanced momentum / earnings edge
regime.zh: 混合行情 — 动量与盈利优势均衡

selection.kind_zh: 盈利 · 内部人 · 评级调整

headline.en: Rate risk runs through its market / growth beta, not a distinct duration leg.
headline.zh: 其利率风险通过市场／成长beta体现，并无独立的久期暴露。

detail.en: Own orthogonal rate (TLT) beta +0.49 ± 0.34 — low / noisy precision. Sector anchor (XLK) reads duration-neutral (-0.06). Negative inflation beta.
detail.zh: 自身正交利率（TLT）beta +0.49 ± 0.34——精度低／噪声。 板块锚（XLK）为久期中性（-0.06）。 负通胀beta。

caveat.en: Single-name secondary betas are noisy — trust the portfolio aggregate, not any one stock's rate beta (measured out-of-sample persistence ≈ 0.36).
caveat.zh: 单一个股的次级beta噪声很大——应相信组合层面的汇总，而非任何单只股票的利率beta（实测样本外持续性约0.36）。
